name: Nagai Osamu
source:
One of the original participants.

He is a kind junior high school teacher who teaches English. He always carries books around with him and records detailed entries in them daily.

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Osamu_Nagai]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
